milestone: Public anonymous chat and mock purchase reliability
status: local milestone completed; subsequent iteration stopped at user request
scope: Anonymous Cookie public chat, mock commerce Agent/port/state machine, and round28 task isolation and bounded wait recovery; support workspace retained without further feature work.

implementation.purchasing: Public chat offers mock catalog, SKU/quantity, cart, quote, explicitly confirmed mock order, separately confirmed mock payment and status. CommercePort uses a separately persisted mock provider; no real payment.
implementation.task_fence: Under conversation coordination, an accepted shopping task commits its automation epoch before reading purchase context or invoking Agent/tools. Owned explicit actions validate original scope/ref/version/signature then commit epoch before domain execution. A failed fence prevents model and business writes; later model error, persistence failure or cancellation does not revive an old refund confirmation.
implementation.wait_recovery: Commerce GET/POST including response JSON are bounded to30 seconds. Timeout/caller abort releases UI wait, leaves the outcome unconfirmed, and never automatically resubmits; explicit GET verifies original purchase. A card refresh removes its own previously verified actions until the new GET succeeds. Late results are ignored.
implementation.constraints: Cookie represents the holding browser. Purchase/order/payment state is independent of chat; clear history does not cancel purchase. Existing workbench remains available.

backend.coverage_scope: Existing selected-core 70% gate, not new commerce API coverage.
backend.static: Ruff app/migrations/3CLI, format496 app+probe, Mypy495 app and3CLI, pip check and diffcheck passed.

frontend.details: 6 transport timeout/cancellation and3 real React controlled-fetch recovery cases; full test/lint/strict tsc/build passed.

validation.independent: Three actual HTTP cancellation/SQL-fence controls passed and independent frontend race review passed; scoped source hashes match.
validation.browser: Round27 real Chrome verified the complete local mock purchase, Cookie, clear and expiry flow. Round28 deadline-specific browser attempt did not complete; deadline behavior was validated in React/controlled-fetch and no new browser acceptance is claimed.

before_after.backend: Native model cart/quote success then exception left previous refund proposal live;3 literal HTTP cases failed before early fence. New11 HTTP cases and controls pass, including SQL fence failure, message insert failure and legitimate same-task refund confirmation.
before_after.frontend: Stalled action previously kept page busy after15min simulated time;9 formal new tests failed before fix and pass after. Late payment response cannot inject a receipt after timeout; status requires explicit GET.

limitations: Mock business facts only; real supplier authentication/payment, production HTTPS Cookie and PostgreSQL concurrency require separate acceptance.
A top-level active purchase GET failure does not globally invalidate independent cards; server ref/version/expiry checks still apply.

Isolated message-history SELECT failure can still appear as an empty history; stream purchase success with failed message persistence has no explicit recovery prompt. These are recorded as future work, with no further iteration after this milestone.
SQLite naive timestamps may display differently after reload; action-audit JSON predicates can scan the conversation without an added JSON index.
The new early fence protects newly accepted shopping requests; pre-upgrade pending checkpoints are not retroactively changed. Drain old instances for any future rollout.
workspace: Current WIP and docker-compose.local.yml retained. No commit, push, deployment, dependency installation or production operation was performed at this milestone.
